## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT create a new app — existing IVX Holdings project at `/home/user/rork-app`
- App is **Expo Go (React Native)**, NOT Swift
- User demands honesty — do NOT claim VERIFIED without proof; no false PASS, no false FAIL
- `github_commit_multi_file` API: `files` must be array of `{path, content}` objects; parameters go inside `input` field (not top-level); `confirmText` must be `"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"`; `confirm: true` required; `contentEncoding: "gzip-base64"` supported for large files (>350KB to bypass Render WAF)

- Backend deploys via GitHub commit + Render auto-deploy (Render watches main branch)
- `npx` is NOT allowed — use `bun x` instead; `bun test` for validation
- `generateOwnerAIAnswer` has complex dependencies (system prompt builder, senior dev prompt, document extraction) that fail when called early in the handler before `mode` const is defined — use `requestIVXAIText` directly instead
- Public chat path works correctly because it calls `requestIVXAIText` directly from `./ivx-ai-runtime`
- Owner AI path LLM calls were failing because `generateOwnerAIAnswer` was called before `mode` const was defined (temporal dead zone `ReferenceError`) — fixed by using `requestIVXAIText` directly with inline system prompt

    - Stage 1: Deterministic safety router (manual override, execution verb detection, destructive action detection, production scope, public/private boundary)
    - Stage 2: Semantic intent classifier (12 intents: explanation, diagnostic, architecture, code_review, code_change, deployment, task_status, data_query, business_analysis, conversation, manual_answer, clarification_required)
    - Key function `isKnowledgeRequest()` — distinguishes "explain X" / "review this code" / "design X" (knowledge → LLM) from "fix X and deploy" / "patch X and commit" (execution → worker)
    - Key function `isExplicitExecution()` — requires explicit action verb + concrete target, excludes knowledge requests
    - `stripManualDirectives()` — removes "no tools", "manual answer", etc. and forwards clean question to LLM
    - `isCannedResponse()` — detects and rejects canned "I am IVX Enterprise Senior Developer" responses
    - `buildClarificationQuestion()` — asks one question when confidence < 0.70
